Retail, now

Rogers — 2011 to 2021

Rogers & Chatr One of the top-5 retailers in Canada — corporate stores, franchise, national retail, e‑commerce, third‑party dealers. Ten years, four director roles: wireless marketing (Rogers brand), VOD, residential product experience, dev & readiness. 1.3M+ wireless customers acquired across Rogers and Chatr. Chatr profitable ahead of schedule, $30M+ EBITDA by year 3. $50M+ structural cost reduction on the ops side.

Earlier — where the frame came from

Freeplay Energy (VP North America) — specialty retail account by account: MEC, REI, LL Bean, Eddie Bauer, Coast Mountain. Shaw On Demand (VP) — the most profitable VOD launch of its kind in Canada. Xbox Canada (Microsoft, Platform Manager) — 70% of Xbox Canada revenue sold through Best Buy, EB Games, Walmart, Costco. And underneath all of it, the training that set the frame: P&G as Assistant Brand Manager, Detergents — where P&G was about selling to banners that retailed, and the first assignment was always a store-check summary.

The surface keeps changing — grocery aisle, big-box, telco channel, Shopify, AI. The mechanics don’t.

The University of Saskatchewan.

Runs through my family. My father, Professor Satya P. Sharma, taught Cultural Anthropology there for 44 years. My mother, Manjari Sharma, was a sculptor whose work sits on the campus. I spent five years there as a student. I am now a guest lecturer there.

Established November 24, 2009. College of Arts & Science. Awarded to undergraduate students in their third or fourth year of the Bachelor of Fine Arts program, specialization in sculpture.
